topic: Advanced React Hooks and Component Patterns
learningObjectives: Use React hooks to manage component state and side effects.
Identify appropriate hooks for common application scenarios.
Apply reusable component patterns to organize frontend logic.

activities.title: Hooks Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each part of a hook example to explore its purpose.

content.concept: React hooks such as useState and useEffect allow functional components to manage state and synchronize with external systems.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Hook used to add local state to a functional component.
The current value stored by the state hook.
Function used to request a state update.
Hook used to synchronize a component with an external system or perform side effects.
Controls when an effect is re-run based on its dependencies.

activities.title: Hook Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the hook that best fits the described scenario.

content.concept: Different hooks address different needs: useState manages local state, useEffect handles synchronization and side effects, useRef stores mutable references, and useMemo can cache expensive calculations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Store a value that changes when the user interacts → useState
Store a value that changes when the user interacts → useRef
config.answer: Store a value that changes when the user interacts → useState

activities.title: Effect Execution Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the basic lifecycle of an effect with cleanup.

content.concept: An effect runs after rendering when its dependencies require it to run. When needed, its cleanup function runs before the effect is re-run or when the component is removed.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Custom Hook Builder
activities.instruction: Build the structure of a reusable custom hook.

content.concept: Custom hooks extract reusable stateful logic into functions whose names conventionally begin with use, allowing multiple components to share behavior without duplicating logic.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

options: Define a function beginning with use
Use the custom hook inside a component
required: Define a function beginning with use
Use the custom hook inside a component
